Incisive papilla - The oral incisive (palatine) papilla is formed of dense connective tissue. It contains the oral parts of the vestigial nasopalatine ducts. Corynebacterium contain inclusion bodies, known as metachromatic granules, which are composed of inorganic polyphosphates (volutin) that serve as energy reserves and are not membrane bound.
